value.rationale: The catenoid is the canonical nonplanar embedded minimal surface; its Gauss map gives an intrinsic normal statistic under genuine area sampling. The exact full normal-pair law has two different near-alignment scaling orders separated by the sharp b² window, with a nontrivial critical profile caused by the bounded normal-latitude difference. The unique height where a strongly nonuniform normal measure nevertheless has isotropic second moments provides a concrete inverse-geometric obstruction, not simply an arbitrary numerical invariant.
